# `liber:share-device@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:share-device` package (`share-device.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem host share - the contract a `host-share` provider serves: a directory of the HOST, reached over virtio-fs, for a DEVELOPMENT machine only.  IT IS NEVER A VOLUME BY ITSELF AND NEVER ANYBODY'S BUT STORAGESERVICE'S. The one consumer is StorageService, which mounts a share behind its own capability-scoped volume API only on a development build, and only when the machine was started with the share - so a process reaches a host directory exactly as it reaches any volume: through a grant for it, or not at all. The system volume, packages and staging never come from here.  READ-ONLY, BY NODE, AND IN THIS SYSTEM'S TERMS. A node is known by a handle this contract hands out, never by the host's node id; an attribute crosses as its kind, size, permission bits and modification time, never the host's inode, device, owner or group. A name is held to the rules a volume's name keeps - no separator, no NUL, not `.` or `..`, at most 255 bytes - in both directions: one that breaks them is refused as asked and dropped as answered. Symbolic links, devices, sockets and pipes are listed as `other` and never opened or followed.

## Interfaces

### interface `share-device`

THE CONTRACT a `host-share` publication serves on each connection.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `describe` | `describe() -> result<share-info, error>` | The share's tag and the bounds. |
| 2 | `root` | `root() -> result<share-node, error>` | The share's root directory, handle 1. |
| 3 | `lookup` | `lookup(dir: u32, name: string) -> result<share-node, error>` | The entry `name` of the directory `dir`, as a node this connection holds until it forgets it. |
| 4 | `attributes` | `attributes(node: u32) -> result<share-node, error>` | A held node's attributes, read again. |
| 5 | `list` | `list(dir: u32, cursor: u64) -> result<share-listing, error>` | One page of a directory's entries from `cursor` (zero for the first). |
| 6 | `read` | `read(node: u32, offset: u64, length: u32) -> result<share-data, error>` | Bytes of a file from `offset`. |
| 7 | `forget` | `forget(node: u32) -> result<unit, error>` | A held node let go; the root is never let go. |
